The following events took place in '''17 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Battle of N'zoth|End]] of the [[Black Fleet Crisis]].<ref name="TT" />
*[[New Republic amnesty bill]] passed.<ref name="NR" />
*[[Brakiss]] came under the tutelage of [[Kueller|Dolph]].<ref name="NR" />
*[[Almanian Uprising]].<ref name="NR" />
**The [[Pydyrian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was almost extinct.<ref name="TEGASxii">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']], p. XII</ref>
*The [[Imperial Skirmishes]]: [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] [[Imperial Space|territory]] was reduced to eight [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] around [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].<ref name="TEA" />
*The marriage of [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] and [[Winter Celchu|Winter]].<ref name="GTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
